notes.title: Update to 1.0.3.6
notes.content:
Okay! What's new?

• Better tutorial. Game explains how to use the Ability Stash
• An attempt was made for fix all the bugs relating to DLCs not working correctly (when you start the game with them for the first time).

notes.title: Small Update 1.0.1.0
notes.content:
• Spanish translation is human translated now - meaning good
• Even having 5 "Bubble Wraps" you had 9 slots - which was a bug, that is fixed now. You can have a maximum of 10 ability slots
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38496447/2e08aa0204e56b568be868794007fd7328a67a01.png[/img]
• Items arrange thematically (sort of) now
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38496447/cded2fd8a87b34144d3beeac21eba136899a3dba.png[/img]
• Sayouri had missing ears on some pictures(R18 DLC) (fixed)

tags.bug: • Even having 5 "Bubble Wraps" you had 9 slots - which was a bug, that is fixed now.
• Sayouri had missing ears on some pictures(R18 DLC) (fixed)

- sometimes ability slots get stuck and you can't put any abilities inside (fixed)
